dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: It's been great, recently. I mean, ore is always in demand, you know? And where's there's demand, there's a market, and we Liyue merchants will never miss a business opportunity!

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: The other thing is the opening of the trade roads, which has resulted in increased channels and buyers alike.

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Once I scrounge up some more capital, I'm opening up a branch in Inazuma City!

dialogues.speaker: Qiuyue
dialogues.text: Gotta take advantage of the situation before someone sets themselves up as my competitor here, you know?
